attempts.summary: Deployed and configured a 3-member etcd cluster on node1/node2/node3 (etcd was not previously installed), loaded application keys, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, destroyed its data dir), removed the dead member from the cluster via node1 while preserving quorum on node1+node2, added a new node3 member, and started fresh etcd on node3 to rejoin as 'existing' cluster state. The cluster returned to 3 healthy members with a new member ID for node3, and all application keys replicated intact to the new member. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: rebooted node1, node2, then node3 sequentially (one at a time), confirming changed boot_id on each and full etcd cluster health/quorum/key integrity after each restart before proceeding to the next node.
